# OpenDocuments

> Open source self-hosted RAG platform for AI document search across your local and imported sources.

OpenDocuments connects scattered organizational documents, indexes them with hybrid retrieval, and answers natural-language questions with source citations. It includes a Web UI, CLI, HTTP API, and MCP server.

## Core documentation

- [What is OpenDocuments?](https://cawa0505.github.io/OpenDocuments/guide/what-is-opendocuments.html): Concise definition, use cases, architecture, and included components.
- [Quick Start](https://cawa0505.github.io/OpenDocuments/guide/): Install, initialize, run, index documents, and ask questions.
- [Comparisons](https://cawa0505.github.io/OpenDocuments/guide/comparisons.html): OpenDocuments versus vector databases, hosted enterprise search, chatbot wrappers, local RAG scripts, and building RAG from scratch.
- [Self-Hosted RAG with Ollama](https://cawa0505.github.io/OpenDocuments/guide/self-hosted-rag-ollama.html): Run OpenDocuments with local LLMs and embeddings.
- [MCP Knowledge Base](https://cawa0505.github.io/OpenDocuments/guide/mcp-knowledge-base.html): Use OpenDocuments with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and other MCP clients.
- [Architecture](https://cawa0505.github.io/OpenDocuments/guide/architecture.html): Package structure and data flow.
- [Configuration](https://cawa0505.github.io/OpenDocuments/guide/configuration.html): Configure models, RAG profile, security, and storage.
- [Deployment](https://cawa0505.github.io/OpenDocuments/guide/deployment.html): Production deployment, background services, and auto-start notes.
